78592.subject: Important: We will soon be deleting your inactive BKK account
78592.body:
![BudapestGO] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=25&F=T)

Dear Oleg Novosadov,
You have not used your BKK account for a long time, so we will delete your
account and the associated data next month in accordance with the
[BudapestGO privacy notice]
(https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=157&F=T) .

Important: if you previously uninstalled the app, your account has not been
deleted
You may have previously uninstalled the BudapestGO app from your phone, but
your BKK account has not yet been deleted. This is why you have received
this notification.

If you’d like to keep your account
All you need to do is start using your account again:
1.

Download the BudapestGO app if you don’t currently have it on your phone.

•

[App Store] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=158&F=T)
•

[Google Play] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=78854635&N=314&L=159&F=T)

2.

Launch the app.
3.

Log in with your existing BKK account.
If you log in, we will not delete your account.

If you do not wish to keep your account
You do not need to do anything. We will automatically delete your account
and any associated data next month.
If you wish to request immediate deletion of your data, you can do so in
the BudapestGO app via the Menu → My Account → Delete Account option.

What can you expect after deleting your account?
Once your account has been deleted, the following features and settings
will not be available until you register again:
•

purchasing tickets and passes,
•

favourite lines and stops,
•

notifications related to your favourites,
•

newsletter settings,
•

passenger security chat,
•

saved locations in the Trip Planning menu,
•

push notifications.

Once your account has been deleted, any fare products you have purchased
that are linked to your account will also be lost and cannot be recovered
later.

If you would like to keep your account and the associated services, please
log in to the BudapestGO app as soon as possible.

Kind regards:
BKK
We have sent you this notice on the legal basis of the performance of a
contractual obligation, in accordance with Article 6(1)(b) of the GDPR.
This information does not constitute commercial or direct marketing
content.
BKK Centre for Budapest Transport
Phone: +36 1 3 255 255 • e-mail: bkk@bkk.hu

Today in AI NOW & BEYOND 🔥 Bring all your data together Anthropic Introduces Hardware Standard for AI Agents AI Highlights of the Week Too Important to Miss AI answers read a brand as one presence, not one channel at a time. Bring all your data together Run social, search, and AI visibility as one story. Connect Planable and SE Ranking to Claude or ChatGPT, and the research, the cross-channel patterns, and the drafts all happen in one conversation. Planable holds social performance. SE Ranking holds search demand and AI visibility. Bring all data together. Which topic is Reddit carrying that we’ve never ranked for? Where did a post move before the keyword data caught up? Which post actually sent people to pricing? Find your answers in one chat by connecting Planable and SE Ranking MCPs. Find out more Anthropic Introduces Hardware Standard for AI Agents The Model Hardware Standard connects lab instruments and factory machines through one shared interface Anthropic has opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard, or MHS, developed with HHMI Janelia. It gives AI agents a common way to understand and operate programmable devices such as microscopes, liquid handlers, robotic arms, and quantum computing equipment. Key Points: One Language for Hardware: MHS translates different machines into simple commands, removing the need for a custom connection for every device. Setup Gets Much Faster: Anthropic says labs can connect equipment in hours or minutes instead of waiting weeks or months. Agents Can Run Experiments: AI can coordinate several instruments, adjust settings as results change, and sometimes recover from hardware errors. Early Tests Look Promising: QuEra used MHS to restore a quantum computer laser lock 99.3% of the time without human help. It Is Built to Be Open: MHS works with programmable devices and different AI models through MCP, command lines, and APIs. Human Oversight Still Matters: The preview remains limited because current models can misunderstand physical failures and cannot control devices without programmable interfaces. Why It Matters: MHS could do for physical equipment what common software standards did for apps: make different systems easier to connect and automate.
